items.title: A CISA aktívan kihasznált Ivanti-sérülékenységre figyelmeztet, rekordot döntött a Microsoft októberi Patch Keddje Az amerikai CISA figyelmeztetést adott ki az Ivanti Connect Secure VPN-megoldását éri…
items.summary: NKI reports CISA's warning on an actively exploited Ivanti Connect Secure VPN flaw, alongside a record-size Microsoft October Patch Tuesday.

items.title: 2026-017: Critical Vulnerability in Cisco Secure Email Gateway
items.summary: CERT-EU flags a critical, actively exploited flaw in the AMP feature of Cisco Secure Email Gateway allowing unauthenticated remote root command execution; patch immediately.

items.title: Stolen AI API keys are paying for hackers’ autonomous scans
items.summary: Bitsight tracked an autonomous hacking tool sold on criminal forums that runs on stolen OpenAI, Anthropic and Google API keys; forum mentions of AI agents, prompt injection and MCP rose 67%.

items.title: DDoS attacks can knock services offline before links reach capacity
items.summary: Netscout recorded 9.1M DDoS attacks in H1 2026 (+~25% YoY), with attacks above 1 Tbps or 1 Gpps up 1,286%, driven by Aisuru and successor botnets.

items.title: AI-Powered Espionage Campaign Targets Government Linux Infrastructure
items.summary: Unit 42 details an AI-powered espionage campaign against government Linux infrastructure using custom malware, web shells and advanced credential theft.

items.title: Critical PwnEscape Linux Kernel Vulnerability Lets Guest VMs Read Host Memory
items.summary: A critical Linux kernel networking flaw dubbed PwnEscape lets VM code read host memory; demonstrated against Vercel cloud sandboxes and confirmed by the vendor.

items.title: Zero-click spyware infecting devices through online ads, researchers say
items.summary: Researchers report zero-click spyware spreading worldwide via targeted online advertisements, marking an escalation in commercial surveillance delivery.

items.title: Tageszusammenfassung - 15.10.2026
items.summary: CERT.at daily summary notes an exploited PAN-OS RCE zero-day (CVE-2026-0322) and attacks backdooring Nextcloud via the Collabora CODE app flaw.

items.title: CISA Adds One Known Exploited Vulnerability to Catalog
items.summary: CISA added CVE-2026-21589, an Atlassian file/directory exposure flaw, to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog based on active exploitation.

items.title: Kritische Sicherheitslücke in Cisco Secure Email Gateway - aktiv ausgenutzt - Updates verfügbar - CVE-2026-76519
items.summary: CERT.at advisory on CVE-2026-76519 (CVSS 9.8) in Cisco Secure Email Gateway AMP: a crafted email attachment enables unauthenticated remote code execution; actively exploited.

items.title: Multiples vulnérabilités dans les produits Palo Alto Networks (15 octobre 2026)

items.title: Vulnérabilité dans Cisco AsyncOS Software pour Secure Email Gateway (15 octobre 2026)
items.summary: CERT-FR confirms active exploitation of CVE-2026-76519 in Cisco AsyncOS for Secure Email Gateway, allowing RCE and integrity compromise.

items.title: Súlyos biztonsági kockázatot jelenthet a QuartzLine PDF-olvasó rejtett backdoor-ja Egy új, QuartzLine néven álcázott Windows-program látszólag egyszerű PDF-nézegető. Lehet vele fájlt megnyitni, keres…
items.summary: Hungary's NKI warns about QuartzLine, a Windows program disguised as a simple PDF reader that contains a hidden backdoor.

items.title: Europol urges early action to protect cryptocurrencies and sensitive data from quantum threats

items.title: 2026-016: Critical Vulnerability in GitLab CE and EE

items.title: 2026-015: Critical Vulnerability in Multiple Atlassian Products

items.title: G7 to launch exercises to guard against AI cyber attacks
items.summary: Reuters reports the G7 will launch exercises aimed at defending against AI-enabled cyberattacks.

items.summary: Trump says he is in talks with Russia and China on denuclearization.
